collection.description: A musician crafts an instrument that barely makes a sound, yet insists it is beautiful.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (musician), a musician, crafts an instrument that barely makes a sound, yet insists it is beautiful.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The instrument is meant for a sleeping infant.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: It was an experiment with unusual wood.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: (child) proposes using it as a percussion prop.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The audience learns silence can be intentional.
